en.headline: Reports say rebuilt Huanggang Port may open on 12 October
en.dek: Local reports said Hong Kong and Shenzhen are aiming for a Monday launch after Golden Week, though officials have not named an official date.
body: The rebuilt Huanggang Port could begin passenger operations on Monday, 12 October, according to reports citing sources familiar with the planning, though the Hong Kong and Shenzhen governments have not announced an official opening date.

The Standard, citing its sister paper Sing Tao Daily, said both sides had settled on 12 October after weighing traffic around the National Day Golden Week from 1 to 7 October. A Monday start would also avoid busier Friday-to-Sunday flows and give officers quieter weekdays to settle into the new layout and procedures. The South China Morning Post separately reported that authorities were targeting that date, subject to operational readiness.

Secretary for Security Tang Ping-keung said on Thursday that the port is still due to open in the fourth quarter. He said large-scale drills had already been run, including an exercise last month involving more than 20,000 civil servants, and that Wi-Fi coverage and anti-slip paving at the public transport interchange had been improved after those tests. He added that lane computer systems, cameras and facial-recognition functions were still being tuned before a date is fixed.

The redeveloped checkpoint is designed for co-location and a collaborative inspection and joint clearance model. Tang has said daily passenger capacity is expected to rise from about 50,000 trips at the existing Huanggang setup to 200,000, and to about 300,000 after the Northern Link spur line opens in 2034. Officials have previously said overall clearance time is intended to fall from around 30 minutes at the present Lok Ma Chau/Huanggang arrangement to about five minutes. Shenzhen has been recruiting residents as experience officers to walk through simulated clearance before the switch-on.

zh.headline: 傳重建皇崗口岸擬10月12日啟用
zh.dek: 本地報道引述消息指港深雙方瞄準國慶黃金周後的周一開通，但官方尚未公布確實日期。
body: 重建後的皇崗口岸有機會在10月12日（周一）開始辦理旅客過關。本地報道引述知情人士指港深雙方正以該日為目標，但香港及深圳當局尚未公布正式開通日期。
《英文虎報》引述姆妹報《星島日報》報道，雙方考慮到10月1日至7日國慶黃金周人流後，傾向選在10月12日開通。選周一亦避開周五至周日較繁忙時段，讓兩地人員有較清靜的工作日熟悉新布局及程序。《南華早報》亦報道當局正以該日為目標，但仍視乎口岸是否準備就緒。
保安局局長鄧炳強周四表示，新口岸仍計劃於今年第四季投入服務。他指當局已進行多次大型演練，包括上月動員逾2萬名公務員的測試，其後已加強口岸Wi-Fi訊號，並在公共運輸交匯處加舖防滑物料。他說，現正調試車道電腦系統、鏡頭及人面識別功能，完成後才會敲定開通日期。
重建後的口岸將實施「一地兩檢」及「合作查驗、一次放行」模式。鄧炳強早前表示，旅客日處理量預期由現時皇崗口岸約5萬人次增至20萬人次，待北環絖支絖於2034年開通後可再增至約30萬人次。當局早前亦指，整體過關時間目標由現時落馬洲／皇崗約30分鐘縮短至約5分鐘。深圳方面正招募市民擔任「體驗官」，在開通前模擬過關流程。
